meta.label: baseline-v2

users.U-active: cursor moving 60 %, pauses 28 %, short idles 12 %, never typing; REAL handling rate
users.U-play: cursor lingering within 6 bw of the cat, erratic, no clicks, 20 % of the present time; REAL handling rate
users.U-mouse-work: mouse work: a press every 2-10 s, the cursor commuting, taskbar reveals every 1-3 min; REAL handling rate
users.U-typing: typing 60 % of the present time, mouse 27 %, pauses 8 %; REAL handling rate

meta.screen: 1920x1200 px @125 % (1536x960 DIP), auto-hide bottom taskbar (work area = screen), app floor inset

layouts.L1: floating Chrome-like window [300,120,1000x840] in front, tab strip from the Edge 156 UIA probe geometry (3 tabs), tab selections
layouts.L2: floating app window [240,160,1240x880] (editor; no tab strip discovered)
layouts.L3: L1 for 10 min, then a maximized window in front for 10 min, alternating (50 %)
layouts.L4b: a maximized window in front U(20,45) min, then L1 for U(3,8) min, alternating (~85 % maximized)
layouts.L4: no app window: only the screen edges are reachable (bands clear)
layouts.L3c: L1 with churn every U(30,90) s for U(5,30) s: another window covers the strip (40 %), the browser is maximized (30 %) or minimized (30 %)
layouts.L1d: L1 with the browser dragged every U(20,60) s by U(80,300) px per axis over U(0.6,2) s (moveStart/moveEnd, moving surfaces)

meta.labels: SIMULATED: real Sim/Mover/host loop/activity monitor/taskbar tracker with synthetic input and provider-shaped surfaces, measured from SimHooks records; MOCKED OS stubs and the v1.2 env fields (buttons, presses, cursor idle, edge bands) from the harness; not the real desktop

provenance.tree: clean `git archive` export of ec690a5 (the v1.2 contract commit C1+C2: v1.1.1 behaviour, every new Mover flag off) with the INT-a harness files (tests/profile/*, scripts/behavior-profile.mjs) copied in; the other packages' in-progress edits were not in it
provenance.harness: tests/profile harness v2: SimHooks records, SimEnv/SimOutput and public CatSim methods only
provenance.command: node scripts/with-lock.mjs profile -- node scripts/behavior-profile.mjs --matrix bands --seeds 8 --hours 3 --scenarios --label baseline-v2 --compact-to <file>
provenance.continuity: the same harness with the v1.2-diagnosis user (U-legacy, --matrix diagnosis, 8 seeds x 3 sim-h) reproduced all 48 runs of out/profile/baseline.json (harness v1) bit for bit: identical transition tables and per-state time to the ms
provenance.labels: SIMULATED (real sim, Mover, host loop, activity monitor and taskbar tracker; MOCKED OS stubs and v1.2 env fields). Bands that need v1.2 records (plannedMs, onHunt, onReaction, onSlip, onEdgeVisit) fail or pass vacuously here by construction; see report.bands
